messages:
Maya (AE): quick sync on Clarion pilot wrap — need final signoff items before we present license options to procurement. TL;DR: align success metrics, confirm eval prompts, call out security Qs, propose pricing path.
Samir (SE): got it. I can share final eval results and the prompt suite. main asks from Clarion: clinical triage accuracy, hallucination rate, and latency.
Jesse (CS): Clarion stakeholder ask: "will this reduce manual triage by 40%?" They want a concrete before/after metric.
Maya (AE): yes, they explicitly asked for ROI numbers for Q2 budgeting. propose we use: reduction in avg handling time (AHT), FTEs deflected, and triage precision @top-1.
Samir (SE): sharing numbers I ran this morning:
```
- Golden set size: 1,200 prompts
- Top-1 precision: 89%
- Hallucination incidents per 1k responses: 3
- Avg response latency (p95): 270ms
- Tokens per request (median): 180
```
Samir (SE): those meet Clarion's latency ask (<300ms p95) and precision target (>=88%) we discussed.
Elena (Sec): quick flag on security: Clarion's procurement sent a standard questionnaire, they require SOC2 type II + customer-managed KMS for PHI. Clarion is on a healthcare cloud so we need to confirm Private deployment timeline.
Maya (AE): @Elena can you confirm Private deploy ETA? They want pilot data residency in their VPC for readouts.
Elena (Sec): current estimate is 6 weeks for a Private pilot on their VPC with our on-prem bundle, assuming SOW and access. Need legal + infra kickoff this week to hit that.
Jesse (CS): also noting integration blockers: Clarion uses an internal HL7-to-JSON adapter. Our connector needs a small mapping change — Samir can drop a patch.
Samir (SE): I'll push a connector pr today. patch diff: small field rename and tokenization tweak.
Maya (AE): pricing path: propose two options for procurement: 1) Reserved pilot term: 3 months, committed compute + reduced per-token; 2) Consumption pilot with overage cap and a conversion credit on annual license. Which is better for Clarion?
Jesse (CS): Clarion finance prefers committed spend for predictability but procurement might try to negotiate consumption. We should present both.
Samir (SE): for the committed option I can model unit economics: expected tokens/day, expected p95 throughput, and reserved GPU sizing. I recommend the gpusize:B2 equivalent for their workload.
Maya (AE): action items: Samir — attach final eval artifacts + prompt set + connector PR by EOD. Elena — confirm Private deploy SOW language and timeline by tomorrow. Jesse — draft ROI slide with before/after AHT and assumed FTE cost. I'll assemble the procurement options and schedule the readout with Clarion execs for next Wed.
Samir (SE): uploading eval bundle: link: https://redwood.artifacts/clarion/pilot-eval-1779991111.zip (contains prompts.txt, eval_results.csv, latency_logs.json)
deploy-bot: deployment started for branch samir/clarion-connector at 1779991500 — status: queued
Samir (SE): noted. connector PR opened: https://git.redwood/sam/clarion-connector/pull/42
Elena (Sec): added required stanza for SOW: "customer-managed KMS and audit log export to customer SIEM". also need Clarion's DPO contact for DPIA signoff.
Maya (AE): ping Clarion for DPO contact in the readout invite. also confirm pilot acceptance criteria we agreed:
- Top-1 precision >= 88% on golden set
- Hallucination incidents <= 5 per 1k responses
- Latency p95 <= 300ms
- Integration throughput >= 250 reqs/min sustained
- Data residency via Private deployment during pilot
Jesse (CS): I'll draft a single-slide acceptance checklist and share before EOD.
Maya (AE): last Q: are there any open enterprise blockers (legal, security, infra) that will prevent go/no-go? list them here.
Elena (Sec): legal needs NDA + DPA countersigned (in flight). infra needs VPC peering creds and a small firewall rule. both are typical but time-sensitive.
Samir (SE): engineering risk: small risk around HL7 edge cases — I've flagged 4 cases in the eval where we drop fields; fix estimated at 2 dev days.
Maya (AE): great. timeline: finalize artifacts by Fri, legal + SOW by next Tue, exec readout Wed. If all green, propose conversion window and draft term sheet day after readout.
Jesse (CS): ack, will prepare the success slide and the suggested conversion term (12mo reserved with 2 mo credit).
Maya (AE): perfect. I'll send the calendar invite and include action tracker. thanks team :thumbsup:
Samir (SE): on it.
Elena (Sec): will follow up with legal and DPO note.
deploy-bot: deployment samir/clarion-connector completed at 1779991850 — status: success
Maya (AE): thanks everyone — will loop Clarion in after we have the slide and SOW.
